newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 117,500 MT exceeded the previous week by 54 percent and were two and three-quarters times the 4-week average.

Major increases for the Netherlands (57,000 MT), unknown destinations (54,000 MT), Germany (45,000 MT), and Japan (27,400 MT) were partially offset by reductions for Mexico (58,600 MT), Canada (15,100 MT), and South Korea (15,000 MT).
Sales of 528,300 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for unknown destinations (299,000 MT), the Netherlands (124,800 MT), and China (52,500 MT).
Exports of 151,100 MT were 52 percent above the previous week, but 28 percent less than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (104,000 MT) and Mexico (28,600 MT).
